stem: A controller schedule worked well early in the crop but now containers dry substantially faster between events. Which response is strongest?
choices: Re-evaluate irrigation against current root-zone depletion, plant size and environmental demand rather than assuming the original schedule remains valid
Keep the schedule unchanged because recipes should not change
Increase nutrients instead of measuring water use
rationale: Water use changes as plants establish and environmental demand changes. Irrigation schedules should be responsive to measured crop and root-zone conditions.
